purpose: Immutable shared-prefix profile. Any speed claim against merc MUST cite this id.

binding.chat_template: none - raw token ids, no template applied
binding.quantization: 4bit (NOTE: 2.1% greedy agreement with bf16 - NOT quality-approved)
binding.sampling: greedy argmax, no temperature, no top-p

accounting.rule: A token counts as PHYSICAL only if it was actually computed. A shared prefix computed once and reused by N streams contributes its length ONCE, not N times.
forbidden: counting reused prefix tokens as inferred
counting exact cache hits as inference
changing quantization without disclosing the quality tier
